# Command-line reference

Each command added by a package has its own `--help`. The list below is what the default install shows; with all groups installed it also has `contracts` (from `agentic-datacenter-remora`) and `scl` (from `agentic-datacenter-iec61850`).

## `agentic-datacenter --help`

```text
usage: agentic-datacenter [-h]
                          {modules,profile,run,agent,bench,data,demo,equipment,facility,gate,scenario,whatif}
                          ...

Data center OT simulator.

positional arguments:
  {modules,profile,run,agent,bench,data,demo,equipment,facility,gate,scenario,whatif}
    modules             Inspect the installed plant modules.
    profile             Check facility profiles.
    run                 Run a profile for a number of simulated seconds.
    agent               List the agents a run can be given: the scripted ones,
                        and the language-model providers.
    bench               Benchmark gates over the scenario library, and merge,
                        freeze and check results.
    data                Write and check the manifest of a measured input
                        series.
    demo                Record a demo with a baseline and one or more gates.
    equipment           Check an equipment registry entry before it is
                        submitted (ADR 0034).
    facility            Compile a facility of your own and check what of the
                        libraries fits it.
    gate                List the installed gates, or run the gate interface
                        suite on one.
    scenario            Run one scenario and write its evidence bundle, or
                        verify a bundle.
    whatif              Play one proposed change as three branches, and check
                        what-if evidence.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
```

## `agentic-datacenter modules --help`

```text
usage: agentic-datacenter modules [-h] {list,graph,lock} ...

positional arguments:
  {list,graph,lock}
    list             Module, version, fidelity level and zone.
    graph            Ports per module, or the wiring of a profile.
    lock             Write modules.lock.yaml from the manifests.

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
```

## `agentic-datacenter profile --help`

```text
usage: agentic-datacenter profile [-h] {validate,schema} ...

positional arguments:
  {validate,schema}
    validate         Validate one profile file, or a facility bundle (ADR
                     0033).
    schema           Write profiles/schema.json.

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
```

## `agentic-datacenter run --help`

```text
usage: agentic-datacenter run [-h] --profile PROFILE [--seed SEED]
                              [--seconds SECONDS] [--quantized]

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --profile PROFILE
  --seed SEED
  --seconds SECONDS
  --quantized        Also print the hash with floats rounded to nine digits
                     (ADC-CI-004).
```
